e.title: **在纯 CPU 上复现 ICLR 2025 的表格模型论文，然后在保险数据上做了论文没做的一组对比**：`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`——**90 次训练（10 数据集 × 3 模型 × 3 种子）**、**逐项对照论文**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而保险那一组的结论是**反的****——**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」**（**LightGBM 泊松偏差 0.5740、**Gini 0.3491，**含调参 131 秒；**最佳神经网络 TabM 为 0.5927／0.3020，**单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛**）**；**⭐ 并逐字记下**一个工具为何失效****（**TabPFN v2 不支持 exposure offset，**故在该任务设定下失真**）
e.title_en: Reproducing an ICLR 2025 tabular model paper on CPU alone and then running a comparison the paper did not run, on insurance data: ninety trainings across ten datasets, three models and three seeds compared item by item against the paper, with the insurance result going the other way, since gradient boosting still leads across the board with a measured deviance and Gini advantage and a training time of about two minutes against twenty-nine minutes for the best neural model which had not converged, and with the reason one tool failed recorded explicitly, namely that it does not support an exposure offset.
e.title_hk: **在純 CPU 上複現 ICLR 2025 的表格模型論文，然後在保險資料上做了論文沒做的一組對比**：`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`——**90 次訓練（10 資料集 × 3 模型 × 3 種子）**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而保險那一組的結論是**反的****（**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」**）**；**⭐ 並逐字記下**一個工具為何失效****（**TabPFN v2 不支援 exposure offset**）
e.summary: **tabm-reproduction**（`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一个**论文复现 ＋ 保险数据原创对比**项目**：**逐字自述为**「**在纯 CPU 环境复现 ICLR 2025 论文 TabM（Tabular Multiple Predictions，Gorishniy et al.，arXiv 2410.24210，官方仓库 yandex-research/tabm）的核心结果，并在保险索赔频率数据（freMTPL2）上做了一组超出论文范围的原创对比实验（深度集成 vs GBDT vs TabPFN）**」。**本次实测**：**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**主语言 Python**、**README 9,140 字节**、**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前两行为** MIT License／Copyright (c) 2026 Flan246**）**、**文件清单实测 46 条**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**，**它的数据来源正是本站已收录的 [[casdatasets]]**（**freMTPL2**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **复现结果是可数的****——**逐字**「**10 个数据集 × 3 个模型（MLP / TabM / TabM-mini）× 3 seed 共 90 次训练，TabM 系在全部 10 个数据集上优于 MLP，方向与论文完全一致**」**，**并给出数值保真的对照**（**逐字**「**california 上 TabM 负 RMSE -0.4410 vs 论文 -0.4414**」**）**；**② **它在保险数据上得到与论文**相反**的结论，并如实写出来****——**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」，**并给出三个可比的数**（**LightGBM 泊松偏差 0.5740／Gini 0.3491／含调参 131 秒；**TabM 0.5927／0.3020／单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛**）**；**③ **它逐字说明某个工具**为什么在该任务上不能用****——**逐字**「**TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真**」。**⭐⭐ 过程留痕**：`report/` **下 8 份阶段报告**（**含** `phase0_notes.md`／`phase1_report.md`／`phase2_report.md`／`phase3_cleanup.md`／`reproduction_report.md`**）**，`env/` **下三份按阶段分开的锁定文件**，`results/` **下逐数据集 CSV 与四份运行日志**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何训练、**未读任何报告正文**。
e.summary_hk: **tabm-reproduction**（`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一個**論文複現＋保險資料原創對比**專案**：**逐字自述為**「**在纯 CPU 环境复现 ICLR 2025 论文 TabM（Tabular Multiple Predictions，Gorishniy et al.，arXiv 2410.24210）的核心结果，并在保险索赔频率数据（freMTPL2）上做了一组超出论文范围的原创对比实验（深度集成 vs GBDT vs TabPFN）**」。**本次實測**：**建立與最後推送同為 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**Python**、**README 9,140 位元組**、**許可 MIT**、**文件清單 46 條**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「反向」**，**其資料來源正是本站已收錄的 [[casdatasets]]**（freMTPL2**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **複現結果可數**（**「**10 个数据集 × 3 个模型 × 3 seed 共 90 次训练**」**，**並給出數值保真對照**）**；**② **它在保險資料上得到與論文**相反**的結論並如實寫出**（**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」**）**；**③ **它逐字說明某工具**為何不能用**（**「**TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何訓練、未讀任何報告正文**。
e.summary_en: The project tabm-reproduction **reproduces an ICLR 2025 tabular deep learning paper and then adds an original comparison the paper did not run, on insurance data**. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-09**, **one star**, primarily Python, **a README of 9,140 bytes**, **an MIT licence** whose file names its copyright holder and year, and **forty-six paths in the file listing**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and its data comes from a package this wiki already holds**, specifically the insurance claim frequency dataset distributed with the collection of actuarial datasets. **Three things are worth copying**: the reproduction result is countable, being ninety trainings across ten datasets, three models and three seeds, with the tabular model family beating the plain multilayer perceptron on every dataset in the same direction as the paper, and with numerical fidelity reported against the paper to four decimal places; it reaches the opposite conclusion on insurance data and writes that out plainly, showing that gradient boosting still leads across the board with a specific Poisson deviance, a specific Gini, and a training time of about two minutes including tuning, against the best neural model at a worse deviance and Gini with twenty-nine minutes per training and no convergence; and it states verbatim why one of the tools could not be used in that task setting, namely that it does not support an exposure offset. **The process is also traceable**: eight phase reports, three separate dependency lock files by phase, per-dataset result files and four run logs. **No training was run and no report body was read this round.**
e.body:
**tabm-reproduction**（GitHub 仓库 `Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一个**论文复现 ＋ 保险数据原创对比**项目**，**README 逐字自述为**「**在纯 CPU 环境复现 ICLR 2025 论文 TabM（Tabular Multiple Predictions，Gorishniy et al.，arXiv 2410.24210，官方仓库 yandex-research/tabm）的核心结果，并在保险索赔频率数据（freMTPL2）上做了一组超出论文范围的原创对比实验（深度集成 vs GBDT vs TabPFN）**」。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-09、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**⭐ 即**该仓库**当天创建、当天推送**）、**★1**、**主语言 Python**、**README 9,140 字节**、**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前两行为** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Flan246`**）**；**文件清单实测 46 条**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 其保险那一组实验的数据正是本站已收录的 [[casdatasets]] 里的** freMTPL2**（**公开保险索赔频率与赔付额数据**）**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 复现的规模与结论都是可数的**——**README 逐字**：**「**论文核心结论 10/10 复现成立：10 个数据集 × 3 个模型（MLP / TabM / TabM-mini）× 3 seed 共 90 次训练，TabM 系在全部 10 个数据集上优于 MLP，方向与论文完全一致。**」**；**并逐字给出数值保真**：**「**数值保真度高：california 上 TabM 负 RMSE -0.4410 vs 论文 -0.4414；30 格中绝大多数偏差小于 seed 间标准差，MLP 行几乎逐位重合（证明 pipeline 保真）。**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它把「**复现成立**」**写成一个可数的分数**（**10/10**）**与一个可加总的训练次数**（**90**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把**自己的数与论文的数并排**（**-0.4410 对 -0.4414**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「**结果一致**」，**而是**给出差多少**；**③ ⭐⭐ 它给出一个**判据**说明偏差可接受**（**「**绝大多数偏差小于 seed 间标准差**」**）**——**⭐ 即**用**随机性本身的尺度**做参照**，**而不是用一个任意阈值**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它在保险数据上的结论与论文相反，而且写了出来**——**README 逐字**：**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**。freMTPL2 索赔频率任务上，LightGBM（Poisson deviance 0.5740、Gini 0.3491、含调参训练 131 s）全面优于最优 NN（TabM 0.5927 / 0.3020 / 单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛）；TabM 稳定优于同结构 MLP（deviance -0.0068、Gini +0.024），集成增益真实存在但不足以反超 GBDT；TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**三件事同时做了**——**① 它给了一个**与所复现论文方向相反**的结果**（**在该任务上树模型仍更强**）**；**② 它把**「**增益存在**」与「**增益足够**」分开说**（**TabM 优于同结构 MLP 是真的，**但**不足以反超 GBDT**）**；**③ 它指出**某个工具为什么不能用**，**而不是让它给出一个坏数字**（**TabPFN v2 不支持 exposure offset**）**——**⭐ 与本词条项目第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ③ 过程留痕可数**——**文件清单实测**：`report/` **下 8 份 markdown**（**逐字含** `datasets_inventory.md`、`phase0_notes.md`、`phase1_prep_notes.md`、`phase1_report.md`、`phase2_data_notes.md`、`phase2_report.md`、`phase3_cleanup.md`、`reproduction_report.md`**）**；`env/` **下三份按阶段分开的锁定文件**（`requirements.lock`、`requirements-paper.lock`、`requirements-phase2.lock`**）**；`results/phase1/` **下** 12 份 CSV（**含** `SUMMARY.csv`、`efficiency.csv` **与逐数据集结果**）**；`results/phase2/` **下** `comparison.csv`、`results.jsonl` **与四份运行日志**；`results/smoke_results.tsv`；`scripts/` **下 5 个脚本**（`run_smoke.py`、`phase1_queue.sh`、`aggregate_phase1.py`、`prepare_fremtpl2.py`、`phase2_fremtpl2.py`**）**。**⭐ 即**「**官方流水线一套环境、**自有增量一套环境**」**被分成**三份锁定文件**——**⭐ 这是本轮四条里**过程留痕**做得最细的一条**。**⭐⭐ ④ 不入库的东西被写明**——**README 的目录结构注释逐字标注**：`data/raw/` **为**「**freMTPL2 OpenML 原始下载（parquet + csv，不入 git）**」**，`.venv/` **与** `.venv-paper/` **各标**「**不入 git**」**，`third_party/tabm/` **标为**「**官方仓库克隆（Apache-2.0）**」**，`third_party/models/` **标**「**tabpfn-v2-regressor.ckpt（TabPFN v2 权重，不入 git）**」。**⭐ 即**「**哪些东西为了让别人能重跑就必须自己下载**」**被逐条说明**（**⭐ 而非只写一句「**数据需自行获取**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[casdatasets]]、[[fremtpl2]] 覆盖**保险公开数据集**，**[[tabpfn]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]] 覆盖**表格基础模型**，**[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]、[[frmtpl-scaling-laws]] 覆盖**在同类数据上的建模研究**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[burncost]]、[[ratecraft]] 覆盖**定价侧的 GLM／GBDT 做法**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**在同一个保险频率任务上，把深度集成、GBDT 与表格基础模型摆在一起比，**并把结论写成与论文方向相反**」这一形态**。**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**其结论只针对**该数据集的该任务设定**，**不能外推到所有表格任务**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[casdatasets]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**保险定价里到底该用树模型还是神经网络**」这一问题上**一份带具体数字与具体任务设定的对照**；**⭐ 而它对本站最有借鉴的三点**：**① 复现要给出「**自己的数 vs 原论文的数**」；**② 「**有增益**」与「**增益足够**」要分开说**；**③ 一个工具**不适用于该设定时**，**要说明原因，而不是让它输出一个坏数字**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行任何训练、没有安装任何依赖、没有复现任何一个数**（**未跑** `run_smoke.py` **或任何 phase 脚本、**未读任何 CSV 或日志**），**故不主张** 90 次训练的结论、**不主张**任何 deviance／Gini／RMSE 数值、**也不主张**其与原论文「**方向一致**」这一判断**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读 `report/` 下 8 份报告任何正文**（**本次只读文件清单与 README**），**故不主张**各阶段的判断、数据集清单、参数设定与「**未收敛**」的判定依据**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实原论文与官方仓库**：**未打开 arXiv 2410.24210、**未访问** yandex-research/tabm**，**故不主张**「**复现了论文核心结果**」**这一说法成立**（**⭐ 本词条只转述其自述**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** freMTPL2 **数据的获取与许可**（**⚠️ 该数据是**公开数据集**，**但**其**再分发条件**本次未核实**）**；**亦**未核实** TabPFN **权重的许可与来源**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** LightGBM 与 TabM 的**超参搜索预算是否可比**（**⭐ 原文给出**「**含调参训练 131 s**」**，**而** TabM**「**单次训练 29 分钟**」**——**⚠️ 两者口径不同，**本词条**不据此判定比较是否公平**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份**（**只读到** LICENSE **里的** `Flan246`**）**；**★1 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 MIT（`LICENSE` 存在，**本次读到前两行**）**，**未读正文**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**仓库内**第三方克隆与权重**均**不入 git**（**自述**）**，**故其许可范围**只覆盖本仓库自身的代码与文档**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建与推送均为 2026-09-09，**都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**在保险频率任务上把深度集成、GBDT 与表格基础模型三方对照、**并写出与论文相反的结论**」这一形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
e.body_hk:
**tabm-reproduction**（GitHub 倉庫 `Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一個**論文複現＋保險資料原創對比**專案**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-09、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**Python**、**README 9,140 位元組**、**許可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前兩行為** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Flan246`**）**；**文件清單 46 條**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**反向：誰接在我們已經收的東西上**」**——**⭐ 其保險那一組實驗的資料正是本站已收錄的 [[casdatasets]] 裡的** freMTPL2**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 複現的規模與結論都可數**——**逐字**「**论文核心结论 10/10 复现成立：10 个数据集 × 3 个模型（MLP / TabM / TabM-mini）× 3 seed 共 90 次训练**」**；**並逐字給出數值保真**「**california 上 TabM 负 RMSE -0.4410 vs 论文 -0.4414**」**與判據**「**绝大多数偏差小于 seed 间标准差**」**。**⭐ 即**不是「**結果一致**」，**而是**差多少被寫明，**且**以**隨機性本身的尺度**為參照**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它在保險資料上的結論與論文相反，而且寫了出來**——**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先。freMTPL2 索赔频率任务上，LightGBM（Poisson deviance 0.5740、Gini 0.3491、含调参训练 131 s）全面优于最优 NN（TabM 0.5927 / 0.3020 / 单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛）；TabM 稳定优于同结构 MLP（deviance -0.0068、Gini +0.024），集成增益真实存在但不足以反超 GBDT；TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真。**」**——**⭐ 即**三件事同時做了：**給出與論文方向相反的結果**、**把「**增益存在**」與「**增益足夠**」分開說**、**指出某工具**為何不能用**。**⭐⭐ ③ 過程留痕可數**：`report/` **下 8 份 markdown**、`env/` **下三份按階段分開的鎖定檔**、`results/phase1/` **下 12 份 CSV**、`results/phase2/` **下** `comparison.csv` **與** `results.jsonl` **及四份日誌**、`scripts/` **下 5 個腳本**。**⭐⭐ ④ 不入庫的東西被寫明**——**目錄註解逐字標注** `data/raw/`**（**parquet + csv，**不入 git**）**、**`.venv/` **與** `.venv-paper/`**、**`third_party/tabm/`**（**官方倉庫克隆，**Apache-2.0**）**、**`third_party/models/`**（**TabPFN v2 權重，**不入 git**）**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[casdatasets]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 複現要給出「**自己的數 vs 原論文的數**」；② 「**有增益**」與「**增益足夠**」要分開說；③ 工具不適用時要說明原因，而不是讓它輸出壞數字**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行任何訓練、沒有安裝任何依賴、沒有複現任何一個數**，**故不主張** 90 次訓練的結論、**不主張**任何 deviance／Gini／RMSE 數值。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀 `report/` 下 8 份報告任何正文**（**只讀文件清單與 README**）。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實原論文與官方倉庫**（**未打開** arXiv 2410.24210、**未訪問** yandex-research/tabm**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** freMTPL2 **的獲取與許可，**亦未核實** TabPFN **權重的許可與來源**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** LightGBM 與 TabM 的**超參預算是否可比**（**兩者口徑不同，**不據此判定比較是否公平**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份**；**★1 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 MIT，未讀正文**；**第三方克隆與權重不入 git，**故其許可範圍只覆蓋本倉庫自身的程式碼與文件**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立與推送均為 2026-09-09，在解凍窗口之內**；**但「在保險頻率任務上把深度集成、GBDT 與表格基礎模型三方對照、並寫出與論文相反的結論」此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
e.body_en:
The project tabm-reproduction **reproduces an ICLR 2025 tabular deep learning paper and then adds an original comparison that the paper did not run, on insurance claim frequency data**. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-09**, **one star**, primarily Python, **a README of 9,140 bytes**, **an MIT licence** whose first two lines name the licence and a copyright holder with the year 2026, and **forty-six paths in the file listing**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, since the insurance experiment uses the dataset distributed with a collection this wiki already holds.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the scale and the outcome of the reproduction are countable.** The README states verbatim that the paper core conclusions are reproduced ten out of ten, across ten datasets, three models and three seeds, ninety trainings in total, with the tabular model family beating the plain perceptron on all ten datasets in the same direction as the paper; and it gives numerical fidelity, reporting a negative root mean squared error of minus zero point four four one zero on one dataset against the paper minus zero point four four one four, noting that most of the thirty cells differ by less than the standard deviation between seeds and that the perceptron rows almost coincide digit for digit, which it presents as evidence that the pipeline is faithful. **A reproduction is therefore expressed as a countable fraction and a total number of runs, its own numbers are placed beside the paper numbers rather than described as consistent with them, and the acceptability criterion is the scale of randomness itself rather than an arbitrary threshold.** **Second, the insurance result goes the other way and is written out**: the README states verbatim that the original insurance experiment shows gradient boosting still leading across the board, giving a specific Poisson deviance, Gini coefficient and training time including tuning for the gradient boosting model, all better than the best neural network at a worse deviance and Gini with twenty-nine minutes per training and no convergence, while the tabular model family does beat a perceptron of the same structure with a deviance improvement and a Gini improvement, so an ensemble gain exists but is not enough to overtake gradient boosting, and finally that one tool distorts on this task setting because it does not support an exposure offset. **Three things are done at once: a result pointing the opposite way from the reproduced paper, a separation between a gain existing and a gain being sufficient, and an explanation of why a tool cannot be used rather than letting it produce a bad number, which matches the project convention of refusing rather than pretending.** **Third, the process is traceable and countable**: eight phase reports including a dataset inventory, phase notes for four phases and a summary reproduction report; three separate dependency lock files, one for the main environment, one for the official pipeline and one for the additional phase; twelve result files for the first phase including a summary and an efficiency table; a comparison file, a JSON lines result file and four run logs for the second phase; a smoke-test result file; and five scripts including a smoke runner, a queue script, an aggregator and two data preparation and experiment scripts. **The official pipeline and the author own incremental work are kept in separate environments, which is the most detailed process record of the round four.** **Fourth, what is deliberately not committed is stated**: the raw download of the insurance dataset is annotated as not going into git, both virtual environments are annotated the same way, the third-party clone is annotated with its licence, and the downloaded model weights are annotated as not committed. **Which items a reader must fetch themselves in order to re-run is therefore spelled out line by line rather than summarised as obtaining the data yourself.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the insurance datasets, the tabular foundation models, modelling studies on the same data, and pricing-side generalised linear and boosting approaches, while this entry supplies a three-way comparison on one insurance frequency task that reaches a conclusion opposite to the reproduced paper. **This entry states plainly that the conclusion applies only to this dataset and task setting and cannot be extrapolated to all tabular tasks.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[casdatasets]] and [[tabpfn-insurance]]**, because **it is a comparison with concrete numbers and a concrete task setting for the question of whether insurance pricing should use tree models or neural networks**, and because **three of its practices transfer directly: a reproduction should print its own number beside the paper number, a gain existing should be separated from a gain being sufficient, and a tool that does not apply to a setting should be explained rather than allowed to emit a bad number**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no training was run, no dependency was installed and no number was reproduced** — no smoke runner and no phase script was executed and no result file or log was read — **so the ninety-training conclusion is not claimed, no deviance, Gini or error figure is claimed, and the judgement that the direction agrees with the paper is not claimed**. **Second, no report body was read**, only the file listing and the README, **so the judgements of each phase, the dataset inventory, the parameter settings and the basis for declaring non-convergence are not claimed; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, neither the original paper nor the official repository was verified**: the preprint was not opened and the official repository was not visited, **so the claim of reproducing the paper core results is relayed rather than established**. **Fourth, neither the acquisition and licensing of the insurance dataset nor the licensing and provenance of the model weights was verified**, and although the dataset is public, its redistribution terms were not checked. **Fifth, whether the hyperparameter search budgets of the two competing approaches are comparable was not verified**: the README gives a training time for one including tuning and a per-run time for the other, **and this entry does not use those two figures to judge whether the comparison is fair**. **Sixth, the author identity was not verified beyond the name in the licence file, and one star is not evidence of quality. Seventh, the licence is MIT and its text was not read, and since the third-party clone and the model weights are reportedly not committed, the licence scope covers only this repository own code and documents. Eighth, creation and push both fall on 2026-09-09 inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the shape of a three-way comparison of deep ensembles, gradient boosting and a tabular foundation model on one insurance frequency task, reporting a conclusion opposite to the reproduced paper, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
